newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: AUSTRALIAN STOCKS TO WATCH TODAY - AUG 12.
newsitem.headline: AUSTRALIAN STOCKS TO WATCH TODAY - AUG 12.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:
Sydney-based insurer HIH Winterthur International Holdings said on Tuesday the planned merger of parent Winterthur Group with Credit Suisse Group may increase its claims paying rating.

Simsmetal reported an annual net profit after tax of A$35.17 million, which it said was in line with its forecasts to the marekt. Fourth quarter profit was A$13.11 million. It also said it expected improved profitability in fiscal 1998.
PMP is expected to report annual earnings before tax and abnormals to be down 15-20 percent. Analysts see a year net fall of about 10 percent to A$56 million.

Cigarette manufacturer Rothmans of Australia Pall Mall (Australia) Ltd could face a lower tax bill than its competitors if industry efforts to overturn a new weight-based tax are unsuccessful, according to industry officials. One problem for Philip Morris Co Inc's Australian unit and W.D. & H.O. Wills Ltd is the fact that Rothmans' cigarettes are generally lighter than those of its competitors.

Pacific Dunlop said on Monday it is looking at options for its joint venture coaxial cable plant in Melbourne which will suspend production in August due to a slow-down in Australia's pay television cable roll-out.
